close_reason: Opinion (per SEC7): stable fixture comments; drift risk is low and inherent to any comment
description: The 16 per-fixture purpose comments added in f11d14b embed concrete facts (body sizes, keyword sets, mailbox placements). When a fixture is changed to serve a new test scenario, every claim in its comment must also be updated manually — the compiler gives no signal of drift. This creates an ongoing maintenance obligation: any future fixture edit has a parallel 'update the comment' step that is easy to forget.
title: seed.rs: fixture comments create stale-drift obligation
